# JustPlugin — All-in-One Server Essentials

**The only essentials plugin you'll ever need for Paper, Purpur, and Folia 1.21.11+**

A single, lightweight, fully configurable JAR that replaces dozens of separate plugins. **160+ commands**, **200+ permissions**, **95+ scoreboard placeholders**, native Folia support, and every command toggleable in config.

> 📚 **Full documentation:** [justplugin.liam.plus](https://justplugin.liam.plus)
>
> Detailed feature guides, command reference, permission tree, configuration reference, placeholder list, formatting guide, and the developer API live on the wiki — this page is just an overview.

---

## What's inside

- **Economy** — balances, `/pay`, PayNotes, Baltop GUI, transaction history, optional Vault integration
- **Teleportation** — TPA, spawn, back, RTP with dimension picker, safe-teleport hazard checks, warmups, cooldowns
- **Warps & Homes** — interactive GUIs, persistent across restarts
- **Moderation** — ban / tempban / IP ban (CIDR), mute / tempmute, progressive warnings, kick, sudo, invsee, echestsee
- **Jail System** — multi-location, temporary or permanent, persistent
- **Kits** — full lifecycle (draft → published → archived), per-kit permissions, cooldowns
- **Player Vaults** — 54-slot virtual storage, configurable per-player limits
- **Ranks (LuckPerms)** — full management GUI, automatic chat prefix/suffix
- **Database** — SQLite, MySQL, or YAML — switch without data loss
- **AFK / Mail / Nicknames / Tags** — configurable announce modes, offline mail, MiniMessage nicks, prefix/suffix tags
- **Vanish & Super Vanish** — with persistent state and full cosmetic hiding
- **Maintenance Mode** — kick screen, MOTD override, server icon swap, group bypass
- **Scoreboard & Tab List** — 95+ placeholders, animated wave gradient, conditional lines
- **Automated Messages** — interval / scheduled / on-the-hour broadcasts with permission filters
- **Backup & Export** — full plugin data snapshots, async I/O
- **Web Config Editor** — every config file editable from your browser, localhost-locked, CSRF + auth-token protected
- **Developer API** — Economy, Punishment, Vanish APIs + 10 custom Bukkit events

[**See the full feature list →**](https://justplugin.liam.plus)

---

## Install

1. Drop `JustPlugin-1.3.jar` into your server's `plugins/` folder.
2. Start the server. Configs auto-generate.
3. Edit `plugins/JustPlugin/config.yml` (or use the in-browser web editor).
4. Reload or restart.

No required dependencies. Optional integrations: **Vault** (economy), **LuckPerms** (ranks GUI + chat prefix/suffix), **PlaceholderAPI**.

---

## Platform support

- Minecraft **1.21.11+**
- **Paper**, **Purpur**, **Folia** — native support on all three
- **Java 21+** required

Bukkit and Spigot are not supported (Paper-exclusive APIs are used throughout).
